summary: Complete frontend testing for AfroCrown mobile APK pre-build. All 15 requested features tested successfully. Landing page with gold/yellow theme works, language selector shows all 6 languages, 'Voir la démo' button opens video, AI Simulation has 30 styles with AFROCROWN cape and 360° view, Booking page has country/city filters with Salon TEST in Brussels and 2 barbers (Marcus, Jérôme), TrimConnect shows Salons Inscrits vs Nouveaux Participants cards with 50 EUR fee, Marketplace loads with products, and navigation between all pages works.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 15 requested features tested and working for APK mobile build. Key findings: 1) AI Simulation has exactly 30 styles with AFROCROWN cape visible, 360° view with 4 rotation positions (Face, Profil Droit, Dos, Profil Gauche), and category filters. 2) Booking page filters by country (Belgique) and city (Bruxelles), showing Salon TEST with 18 AI-generated haircut photos and 2 barbers (Marcus - Expert Dégradés & Waves, Jérôme - Maître Tresseur & Locks). 3) TrimConnect shows two distinct cards - 'Salons Inscrits' with free access and 'Nouveaux Participants' with 50 EUR fee. 4) Marketplace loads products with category filters. All pages use gold/yellow (F59E0B/FFD700) theme consistently.
